Shaggy, salt-and-pepper grey hair with a thick, weathered beard. Narrow, piercing steel-blue eyes with a stern expression. Apparent age in late fifties with a rugged, mature face. Broad-shouldered, muscular build. Wears traditional Norse leather and fur armor in deep brown and charcoal tones with a heavy wool cloak. Features a wide leather belt with a heavy iron buckle and thick leather wrist guards.
BODY COLOR: fair skin
